bullets: The Freebuff landing screen now always shows ads, even on short terminal windows, instead of hiding the ad banner when the terminal is under 18 rows tall.
The Freebuff SDK's BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) connection manager now lets you add a new model to an existing provider connection without re-entering your API key or provider URL.
Freebuff removed Kimi K3 Eco from the list of models that paid subscribers can use with their monthly allowance, because that model's provider has retired it.
A new full-screen image ad slot now appears in the Desktop app sidebar and right panel where ads are shown, with defined size and shape requirements for advertisers.
Freebuff added a new experimental system that could eventually let an in-house model pick which first-party ad to show to Tier-1 users, but it ships disabled by default.
The promotional banner telling you that GLM 5.3 Flash was on a limited-time deal has been taken down now that the September 30 deadline has passed.
A marketing message shown to users blocked from the full model catalog because of their country has been simplified: the short tagline line beneath the headline is gone.
The company updated the date stamp that records when its privacy policy was last changed, moving it from late September to October 1.
